title: Why Kobe Couldn't Dunk At 12 Years Old 🏀 #shorts
description:
Returning to the US as a scrawny kid who could barely touch the backboard while 12-year-olds threw down windmills, Kobe Bryant confessed he was completely outmatched physically. Instead of quitting, he committed to mastering one specific skill every year until his patient obsession completely wiped out their head start. ⚡
